import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import warnings

# Suppress warnings for a cleaner output
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", font_scale=1.1)

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Titanic Survival Factors', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex ---
sns.pointplot(data=df, x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex',
              palette={'male': 'skyblue', 'female': 'salmon'},
              ax=axes[0, 0], dodge=True)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(['1st', '2nd', '3rd'])
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sex')
axes[0, 0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter('{:.0%}'.format))

# --- Plot 2: Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors ---
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='age', hue='alive',
            fill=True, common_norm=False,
            palette={'no': '#E63946', 'yes': '#588157'},
            alpha=0.6, ax=axes[0, 1])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Survived', labels=['Yes', 'No'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlim(0, 80)

# --- Plot 3: Survival Rate by Family Size ---
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
sns.pointplot(data=df, x='family_size', y='survived', color='purple', ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Total Family Members Aboard', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter('{:.0%}'.format))

# --- Plot 4: Fare Distribution by Class and Survival ---
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='class', y='fare', hue='alive',
              jitter=0.3, alpha=0.6, dodge=True,
              palette={'no': '#E63946', 'yes': '#588157'}, ax=axes[1, 1])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Fare (Log Scale)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_yscale('log') # Use log scale due to fare skewness
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
axes[1, 1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.ScalarFormatter())


# Adjust layout to prevent overlap
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
